adj = defaultdict(list)
for u,v in edges:
    adj[u].append(v)
    adj[v].append(u)

degrees = [len(adj[i]) for i in range(n)]
print("Degrees:", degrees)
print("Min degree:", min(degrees))
print("Max degree:", max(degrees))
print("Number of edges:", len(edges))

# Check bipartite (chromatic number <=2)
from collections import deque
color = [-1]*n
bipartite = True
for i in range(n):
    if color[i] == -1:
        color[i] = 0
        q = deque([i])
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            for v in adj[u]:
                if color[v] == -1:
                    color[v] = 1-color[u]
                    q.append(v)
                elif color[v] == color[u]:
                    bipartite = False
                    break
            if not bipartite:
                break
    if not bipartite:
        break

print("Bipartite:", bipartite)
